description: In session.rs, read_command_line loops calling reader.read_u8().await for each byte, accumulating into a Vec<u8> until CRLF is found. tokio::io::AsyncBufReadExt::read_until('\n', &mut buf) performs the same accumulation in a single syscall-batched read with no per-byte await overhead. The current implementation incurs an await point per byte, which adds scheduler overhead and is especially costly for long command lines. Fix: use read_until(b'\n', &mut buf) and then validate/strip the CRLF from the result.
title: smtp: read_command_line reads one byte at a time instead of using read_until
